server.name: Subagent MCP
server.content: text-only Markdown followed by one final subagent-mcp-meta JSON fence

runtime_list.purpose: List runtime capabilities, health, policy, and circuit state

runtime_check.purpose: Run local compatibility checks or explicitly refresh provider quota

runtime_configure.purpose: Apply a revisioned runtime configuration patch

runtime_canary.purpose: Run the separately gated live adapter canary

project_scan.purpose: Scan project executable content and hashes

project_trust.purpose: Trust or revoke exact project path and hash entries

write_set.conflict_rule: equal, ancestor, or descendant active scopes conflict; disjoint scopes may run concurrently

agent_spawn.purpose: Create one conversation and its first execution

agent_status.purpose: Read normalized conversation status and events

agent_result_read.purpose: Read one hash-bound slice of a persisted terminal result without calling a provider

agent_send.purpose: Continue one native session, optionally relaying one hash-bound result artifact

agent_wait.purpose: Wait locally for one to eight targets without interrupting running agents

agent_close.purpose: Close the logical conversation without deleting native state

workspace_release.purpose: Release an owned workspace after safety checks
